title: China Spied on Taiwanese President’s Son – in the US
author: Brian Hioe
text:
Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te
Credit: Official Photo by Liu Shu fu / Office of the President, ROC (Taiwan)-8a90004bfc-k
News broke earlier this month that the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) had arrested real estate agent Wanying “Heather” Zhang for spying on Lai Ting-yu, the eldest child of Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te. Zhang lived in Irvine, California, where she worked as a real estate agent. She was originally from Changsha, China, before emigrating to the United States and naturalizing. Lai Ting-yu is not a political figure – members of the Lai family tend to keep a low profile. Lai Ching-te’s wife, First Lady Wu Mei-ju, does not often make public appearances with her husband. Arguably, the most famous members of the Lai family outside of Lai Ching-te himself are the family dogs, Murphy, Banban, and Luke, though Luke has since passed away. Banban in particular is best known as a dog that had lost a leg to a wild boar trap before being adopted by the Lai family.[...]
